owner: Patrick Craven, Top Shelf Service LLC

decision_groups.name: InvitationLifecycle
contract_facts: Invitation lifecycle changes are audited under IDN-16.
Invitation/token lifetime remains owner-undecided under OQ-IDN-2.
Offboarded-identity invitation handling remains owner-undecided under OQ-IDN-5 and fails closed under IDN-20.
Retries must not create duplicate invitations under TXN-5.
missing_decisions: Canonical Invitation lifecycle state-set name and values.
Which transitions consume, expire, revoke, reject, or otherwise terminate an Invitation.
Whether Invitation owns a distinct token record or references another registered single-use token concept.

decision_groups.name: SingleUseTokenLifecycle
contract_facts: Single-use tokens are cryptographically generated and stored only as hashes under IDN-7/IDN-8.
Every token is consumable at most once under IDN-10.
Every token is revocable before expiry under IDN-11.
Expired, revoked, or otherwise invalid setup/reset tokens cannot authenticate under IDN-14.
missing_decisions: Canonical single-use-token lifecycle state-set name and values.
Whether SetupToken and PasswordResetToken share one state set.
Exact transition model for consumption, expiry, and revocation.

decision_groups.name: ReconciliationRecordLifecycle
contract_facts: Ambiguous external effects cannot be retried automatically under TXN-6.
Canonical provider state must be read before retry under TXN-7.
Unreadable provider state preserves ambiguity and forbids retry under TXN-8.
Ambiguous and partial-failure outcomes must be explicit states and cannot be reported as success under TXN-9.
missing_decisions: Canonical ReconciliationRecord lifecycle state-set name and values.
Canonical transitions for readback-success, readback-no-effect, unreadable-provider-state, and terminal resolution.
Whether provider-specific detail is modeled as data on the generic record or requires provider-specific semantic extension.
